title: Closed algebraic subspaces, quasi-coherent ideals and arbitrary pullback
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and work with algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Closed immersions are representable and become closed immersions of schemes on every scheme test [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Modules are on the small etale ringed sites, with quasi-coherence [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] and tensor pullback and direct image [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Let $X$ be such a space. Closed subspaces $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$, up to isomorphism over $X$, correspond bijectively to quasi-coherent ideals $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$, by $\mathcal I=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$. For the subspace associated to $\mathcal I$, the quotient map identifies $i_*\mathcal O_Z$ canonically with $\mathcal O_X/\mathcal I$. For every morphism $p:X\prime\to X$, let $i\prime:Z\prime=Z\times_X X\prime\hookrightarrow X\prime$ be the inverse image [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Its ideal is $\operatorname{im}(p^*\mathcal I\to\mathcal O_{X\prime})$, and there is a canonical isomorphism $p^*(i_*\mathcal O_Z)\simeq i\prime_*\mathcal O_{Z\prime}$ which identifies the tensor pullback of the quotient map with the structure quotient map on $X\prime$. These identifications preserve the units and commute with successive pullbacks. No flatness, finite-type, finite-presentation or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 03MB, lemma-closed-immersion-ideals, bijection and its proof using the ideal image on scheme tests; quotient-pullback formulation of that construction.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-ideal-closed-subspace-correspondence] to $X$. It supplies the asserted bijection, and says that the structure map $q:\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z$ is surjective with kernel $\mathcal I$. Thus $q$ induces the unique isomorphism $\mathcal O_X/\mathcal I\simeq i_*\mathcal O_Z$ carrying the quotient map to $q$: locally a class $[a]$ maps to $q(a)$; surjectivity gives local preimages and the kernel assertion makes their classes independent of the lift. The same cited statement applied to $p$ says that $Z\prime$ is the closed subspace with ideal $\mathcal J=\operatorname{im}(p^*\mathcal I\to\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ and that $q\prime:\mathcal O_{X\prime}\to i\prime_*\mathcal O_{Z\prime}$ is surjective with kernel $\mathcal J$.

source.place: Tag 03MB (lemma-closed-immersion-ideals), and the paragraph after definition-inverse-image-closed-subspace.

proof.text: By [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], $p^*$ is left adjoint to $p_*$. Regard $q$ as the coequalizer of the inclusion and zero maps $\mathcal I\rightrightarrows\mathcal O_X$ in module sheaves; a module map out of $\mathcal O_X$ descends through $q$ exactly when it kills $\mathcal I$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits] to this finite, hence small, diagram. Consequently $p^*q$ is the coequalizer of $p^*\mathcal I\rightrightarrows p^*\mathcal O_X$. By [lem-trf-space-chart-adjunction-tensor-realization], the specified left adjoint $p^*$ is identified, compatibly with units and local tensors, with the ringed tensor pullback $\mathcal O_{X\prime}\otimes_{p^{-1}\mathcal O_X}p^{-1}(-)$ of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]; for $\mathcal O_X$ this gives $p^*\mathcal O_X\simeq\mathcal O_{X\prime}$ by $b\otimes a\mapsto b\,p^\sharp(a)$, inverse $b\mapsto b\otimes1$. Its coequalizer is therefore $\mathcal O_{X\prime}/\mathcal J$. This uses preservation of cokernels, not preservation of the injection of $\mathcal I$.

source.place: Tag 0038 (lemma-adjoint-exact), part (1); sites-modules.tex Tag 03D7 (lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules), with its tensor formula.

proof.text: The two coequalizers in steps 1 and 2 give a unique isomorphism $\beta_p:p^*(i_*\mathcal O_Z)\simeq i\prime_*\mathcal O_{Z\prime}$ satisfying $\beta_p\circ p^*q=q\prime$, after identifying $p^*\mathcal O_X$ with $\mathcal O_{X\prime}$. Hence it sends $1\otimes1$ to $1$, and on locally lifted tensors sends $b\otimes[a]$ to the class of $b\,p^\sharp(a)$. Multiplication is respected by this formula. For a further pullback $r:X\prime\prime\to X\prime$, the composition isomorphism $r^*p^*\simeq(p\circ r)^*$ of [lem-trf-space-chart-adjunction-tensor-realization] sends $c\otimes(b\otimes m)$ to $c\,r^\sharp(b)\otimes m$. Both the successive comparison and the comparison for $p\circ r$ thus take a local lift $c\otimes(b\otimes[a])$ to $[c\,r^\sharp(b)\,(p\circ r)^\sharp(a)]$. Equivalently both have the same composite with the epimorphic pulled-back quotient map; they are equal. Identity pullback gives the identity by the same formula. This proves the asserted unit and successive-pullback compatibilities.
